## What's new in 1.1
**New** - **See which repositories count toward your profile.** The Repository Browser has a Your Commits column and Contributed / Not Contributed filters, so you can tell why the Dashboard counts fewer repositories than were scanned. - **A reminder to add every email you commit with.** The Dashboard explains that only commits from your added emails count (work, old jobs, personal), with a link to add more. - **Pull Requests is marked Beta.**
**Improved** - **No more freezing on big repositories.** Stats now refresh in the background when commits land from a terminal or editor, and large histories parse and scroll faster. - **Scan your whole home folder in one click.** Adding a folder now opens on your home folder and recommends it, so no repository is missed.
**Fixed** - The "When commits land" chart in a repository's Stats was empty for any range except All Time. - In Settings › Appearance, the tick now follows your pick of graph palette, diff colors and code theme.

## GitGrain 1.0
The first release.
- **Install:** open GitGrain.dmg and drag GitGrain into Applications. - **Requires** macOS 26 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel. - **Updates:** GitGrain checks once a day, or choose GitGrain ▸ Check for Updates… to check now.
